scripts.build: npm run generate:protobuf && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('generated', 'dist/StreamClient/generated', {recursive: true})"
scripts.generate:protobuf: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('generated', {recursive: true})" && pbjs -t static-module -w commonjs -o generated/messages.cjs messages.proto && pbts -o generated/messages.d.cts generated/messages.cjs
